text:
marta: FYI dedicated-prod-eu1 GPU pool fully saturated, queue backpressure spiking and a bunch of requests are being routed to hosted fallback (observed 429s). Seeing some requests bounced between router and hosted which inflates latency.

ops-bot: ALERT capacity_exhausted detected on dedicated-prod-eu1 (INC-8342). Affected pools: gpu-pool-3. Autoscaler error rate rising.

samir: I'm digging in. Autoscaler logs show repeated node boot failures: 
```
ERROR autoscaler: node_launch_failed count=5 reason="image-post-bake-corruption v13"
```
@leo can you look at image/template health?

leo: Confirmed: instance-template points to image v13 which has bad init script causing boot loops. Quotas are fine. Rolling template back to v12 now and will re-trigger scale up. ETA ~6-9m for new healthy nodes.

irene: Proposed mitigations: (1) Pause hosted fallback for tenant tag enterprise/* to avoid sending sensitive/critical traffic to hosted; (2) Ask hosted team for emergency per-tenant RPS bump for critical customers while we recover; (3) For non-SLA routes, switch to quantized model variant and smaller batch sizes to reduce memory. Thoughts?

marta: Do 1 and 2 immediately. 3 is OK but only for low-priority routes (batch jobs, offline recommender). We must not degrade enterprise chat flows.

samir: Done step 1: updated router rule (route_id=route-eu1-enterprise-pause) to block enterprise->hosted fallback. Step 2: sent emergency quota request to hosted ops via internal API: 
```
curl -X POST https://internal.ops.redwood/quota/adjust -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"scope":"tenant:enterprise","add_rps":50,"ttl_mins":30}'
```

hosted-oncall: Temporary quota increase approved for enterprise tenants (+50% RPS for 30m). Ticket: INC-8342-HTD.

leo: Template rolled back to v12 and new VMs are joining the pool. Health checks passing on 4/5 new nodes, one still initializing. Recommend reducing hosted weight while pool recovers.

marta: Lowered hosted fallback weight for eu1 from 0.6 -> 0.25 in the router config. Change rolled.

irene: Applied config optimizations for low-priority routes: prefix-cache TTL -> 30s, reduced default batch size 64->32, and switched /recommender endpoints to quantized model variant (cfg-id cfg-2891).

samir: Telemetry update: queue depth for dedicated-prod-eu1 down ~35% since rollback + hosted adjustments. p95 latency for eu1 endpoints improved from ~1.2s to ~420ms. 429s for enterprise tenants dropped to near zero after pause + quota bump. Monitoring for sustained stability.

leo: Filing a follow-up to add image checksum verification into rollout gating and a CI alert on repeated boot failures (PR coming). Also adding instance-template drift detection to infra metrics.

marta: Great. Follow-ups: (A) postmortem focusing on image bake and autoscaler gating, (B) update runbook to require ops approval before cross-region failover (we almost hit cross-region routing), (C) automated hosted-quota playbook for emergency RPS increases. I'll create tickets and assign. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-8342 status -> mitigated; in monitoring. Please add notes and link PRs to the incident ticket.

marta: Thanks team, keeping this channel for any regression alerts.
